== Cultural Properties ==
; Designated Cultural Property of Fujisawa City (Crafts)
* The Buddhist bell of Mitama Shrine, {{ill|Bonshō|en|Bonshō|qid=Q8192099|lt=Buddhist Bell|1=Bonshō}} - {{ill|1966|en|1966|qid=Q2649|lt=1966|1=1966}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|en|Shōwa era|qid=Q327567|lt=Showa|1=Shōwa era}} 41) {{ill|January 17|en|January 17|qid=Q2264|lt=January 17|1=January 17}} designated<ref>[http://www.city.fujisawa.kanagawa.jp/bunkazai/kyoiku/bunka/bunkazai/mokuroku.html Designated Cultural Properties List] - Fujisawa City, viewed April 8, 2018.</ref>. It was cast during the {{ill|Muromachi period|en|Muromachi period|qid=Q334845|lt=Muromachi period|1=Muromachi period}} in {{ill|1386|en|1386|qid=Q6355|lt=1386|1=1386}} (in the 3rd year of {{ill|Shitoku|en|Shitoku|qid=Q1146202|lt=Shitoku|1=Shitoku}}) and was originally located at {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture|1=Chiba Prefecture}}’s {{ill|Katori Shrine|en|Katori Shrine|qid=Q372380|lt=Katori Temple|1=Katori Jingū}}, but was purchased in {{ill|1872|en|1872|qid=Q7753|lt=1872|1=1872}} ({{ill|1872|en|1872|qid=Q7753|lt=Meiji 5|1=1872}}) by the villagers of Hatori.
<gallery>
File:Bell of Hatori mitama shrine,Fujisawa city,Japan.jpg|Belfry Bell
File:Text of the bell of Hatori mitama shrine,Fujisawa city,Japan.jpg|Inscription of Katori Temple on the bell
</gallery>

== Festivals ==
* January 1: New Year's Festival (Saitan‐sai)
* September 6: Annual Festival (Reitaisai)
